enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Turn onto back. Breathe deeply. Move arm. Turn to left side again. Remain still.

Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Pick up clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and cereal. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Put milk back. Open cupboard. Take out mug and tea bag. Put tea bag in mug. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into mug. Add milk. Stir. Eat cereal. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to Monash University via train and bus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap on card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Enter station. Tap on card. Walk to platform. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Look at phone. Get off train. Walk to campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Arriving at campus and preparing for classes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to campus. Enter building. Walk to classroom. Find seat. Sit down. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Open notebook. Write date. Read over notes. Wait for class to start.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending social work classes and seminars
enriched_activities.desc: Listen to lecture. Take notes. Write key points. Raise hand. Ask question. Discuss in group. Read handout. Highlight text. Write summary. Present group findings. Listen to feedback. Take more notes. Break for 10 minutes. Walk to bathroom. Return to seat. Continue listening.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating packed lunch and reviewing notes
enriched_activities.desc: Open backpack. Take out lunch box. Open lunch box. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Take out notes. Read notes. Highlight important points. Write additional notes. Drink water. Close lunch box. Put lunch box back in backpack. Continue reading notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending more classes and group study
enriched_activities.desc: Attend class. Listen to lecture. Take notes. Participate in group discussion. Share ideas. Write on whiteboard. Read case study. Discuss with peers. Take notes on group study. Review notes. Ask questions. Answer questions. Summarize group findings. Present to class. Listen to feedback. Pack up materials.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to aged-care facility for evening shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap on card. Find seat. Sit down. Look at phone. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Enter station. Tap on card. Walk to platform. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Get off train. Walk to aged-care facility.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as aged-care support worker (evening shift), including a break to eat a packed flexitarian dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter facility. Clock in. Receive handover from previous shift. Walk to resident room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet resident. Assist resident with meal. Help resident eat. Clear dishes. Walk to next resident. Assist with toileting. Help resident to bed. Check on residents. Walk to break room. Open lunch box. Eat dinner. Drink water. Return to work. Complete paperwork. Clock out.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap on card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Enter station. Tap on card. Walk to platform. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Look at phone. Get off train. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting reminders and going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Pick up phone. Open reminder app. Set alarm for 6:30 AM. Set reminder for assignment deadline. Place phone on bedside table. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.
